Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted fantasy chapter region map for Asterveil Fateweave, no borrowing from other projects. Portrait image 1080x2340 aspect 6:13, opaque edge to edge, high three-quarter overhead view, hand-painted polished anime fantasy terrain, charming miniature landmark scale but serious escalating danger. Match the supplied current-game references' navy/violet masonry, champagne gold inlays, cyan waterfalls, emerald grasses, soft brush detail and top-left light. Reference overview only establishes materials; create a single coherent NEW geographical region, no panels.
EXACTLY TEN distinct landmark vignettes connected in sequence by one continuous pale parchment-gold travel road. Road winds upward from bottom to top through all ten clearings. Coordinates below in a 1080x2340 canvas. Each NODE is plain irregular natural clear ground at least 150x150, with its landmark just behind/alongside it; NEVER paint a circle, pedestal marker, icon, number, dot, badge or label on these clearings. Keep clearings centered accurately.
Bottom to top:
1 ground center (360,2140), ruined warm frontier fort above-left, sunlit green meadow, broken stone gate, ONLY ONE small blue-gold tent and tiny warm campfire beside fort at (160,2180).
2 (730,1940), dark emerald rift-twisted thorn forest, huge looping roots and thorn branches.
3 (370,1730), violet crystal rift scar, angular purple fissures splitting stone terrain.
4 (720,1530), blue moon-shadow lake, silver moon reflection, crescent shrine, islets and pale causeway.
5 (350,1320), abandoned mine, dark timber entrance, tiny ore cart, cyan-blue frozen THREAD veins flowing through excavated rock, NOT generic jewel mountain.
6 (730,1110), petrol-teal poisonous swamp, acid-green pools, reeds, stilt alchemy hut and small potion still; safe pale planks.
7 (350,900), charcoal ash fortress, burnt gate, muted red cloth, glowing ember windows, dark ash slopes.
8 (730,690), fallen floating city, shattered tall blue-violet arches and champagne inlays, inverted floating island foundations, cyan waterfalls; fractured bridge connecting mainland.
9 (360,480), copper grass fallen-star field, dark meteor crater rims and cyan-white star stones, lavender dust.
10 (650,245), most dangerous grand EMPTY rift throne, obsidian-violet throne behind the clearing, suspended fractured pale platforms and severed luminous filaments over deep violet abyss, enormous ominous violet rift, unique dominant summit silhouette, no person.
Coherent transitions between biomes, rugged terrain near borders, not separate floating stickers. Road passes through node centers and connects 1 to 2 to 3 to 4 to 5 to 6 to 7 to 8 to 9 to 10 with broad gentle bends; keep it visible without branches or shortcuts. Rich landscape fills canvas, warm bottom gradually cools to darkest violet top. Top-left 230x190 and bottom-right 230x190 quiet terrain for HUD. Clear phone readability. No sky horizon, no border, no parchment sheet, no compass. ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, digits, labels, UI, node rings, map markers, stars as achievement badges, locks, characters, weapons, logos or watermark. Painted meteor stones are allowed only in location 9.
